title: Moment inequalities for higher-order (inverse) stochastic dominance
summary: Stochastic dominance has been studied extensively, particularly in the finance and economics literature. In this paper, we obtain two results. First, necessary conditions for higher-order inverse stochastic dominance are developed. These conditions, which involve moment inequalities of the minimum order statistics, are analogous to the ones obtained by Fishburn (1980b) for usual higher-order stochastic dominance.
